```yaml
name: E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y bats jq curl

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: |
          docker build -t dkron-e2e .

      - name: Start test cluster
        run: |
          make e2e-start

      - name: Wait for cluster startup
        run: |
          timeout 120s bash -c '
            until curl -s http://localhost:8080/health; do
              echo "Waiting for cluster to be ready..."
              sleep 5
            done
          '

      - name: Run E2E tests
        id: e2e-tests
        run: |
          make e2e
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Collect container logs on failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          docker ps -a --format "{{.ID}} {{.Names}}" | while read id name; do
            echo "=== Logs for $name ==="
            docker logs $id 2>&1 || true
          done

      - name: Cleanup resources
        if: always()
        run: |
          make e2e-stop || true
          docker system prune -f || true
```

yaml:
name: E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y bats jq curl

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: |
          docker build -t dkron-e2e .

      - name: Start test cluster
        run: |
          make e2e-start

      - name: Wait for cluster startup
        run: |
          timeout 120s bash -c '
            until curl -s http://localhost:8080/health; do
              echo "Waiting for cluster to be ready..."
              sleep 5
            done
          '

      - name: Run E2E tests
        id: e2e-tests
        run: |
          make e2e
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Collect container logs on failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          docker ps -a --format "{{.ID}} {{.Names}}" | while read id name; do
            echo "=== Logs for $name ==="
            docker logs $id 2>&1 || true
          done

      - name: Cleanup resources
        if: always()
        run: |
          make e2e-stop || true
          docker system prune -f || true
